HRA Analysis: SERENA LOVE (8) looked set to run out a certain winner two starts ago before making a break in the last 50 metres and throwing away the race. She bounced back nicely last time out simply proving too good for her rivals. She draws well to follow the likely leader and should get her chance. SECOND TO NUN (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in this race. One of her latest starts leading she was only run down late by the very smart young trotter Raffie Jay. She should be hard to run down. KICKING HORSE (2) secured a good run behind the leader two starts ago and was running on late into second behind Nonis Gold Class in what became a dash home. He draws to do no work early in this race and should be running on late. ALADDIN SANE (4) put in a good run last time out when running on strongly late into second behind SERENA LOVE (8). He may be shuffled back a touch from the draw and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: SERENA LOVE (8), SECOND TO NUN (1), KICKING HORSE (2), ALADDIN SANE (4) SUGGESTED BET: SECOND TO NUN (1) to win.

BLING YOUR A GAME (8) draws very awkwardly inside the back row in this race but does appear to bring some of the best form into this race. Seconds behind Maywyn Son Of Lou and Yippee Kiyay look good form for a race of this nature and with luck in running he should be hard to beat. CHERRY SURPRISE (2) was terrific on debut when running on strongly late behind Shine Like Me before being left without cover in her following start and finished last but wasn’t beaten too far. She should be suited by the good draw and will be hard to hold out late. DOUBLEFAULT (9) has been knocking on the door of a maiden win having put together three consecutive seconds. He got back last time out and chased hard there into second behind Big Reputation. He should be running on well again. RESERVED FOR ME (6) ran a good third on debut behind stablemate Big Reputation. She is likely to have derived a lot of benefit from the outings and should run well in her second start. SELECTIONS: BLING YOUR A GAME (8), CHERRY SURPRISE (2), DOUBLEFAULT (9), RESERVED FOR ME (6) SUGGESTED BET: CHERRY SURPRISE (2) to win.

ROCKIN SWEET (2) has reasonably good gate speed and may look to press forward and look for the lead. He got shuffled back last time out and was running on well into fourth behind Pinkchampagne. He should run well. LUVN OSMAN (8) will be relying on a bit of luck in this race drawn behind a horse which can mix his gate speed. He ran a good third last time out behind She Maybe Bettor in a similar race to the one he lands in here. TAKE A CHANCE (1) hasn’t been showing a lot of gate speed in his races recently which could prove tricky from the good draw. He will likely look to be driving through and leading early and if he could lead he would take some running down. KINGSBURY (10) appeared to be outclassed last time out when leading and giving ground late to finish seventh in a race he may have been better suited driven with a sit. He drops in class and may find this more suitable and could be running into it late. SELECTIONS: ROCKIN SWEET (2),LUVN OSMAN (8), TAKE A CHANCE (1), KINGSBURY (10) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKIN SWEET (2) to win.

FATE AWAITS (4) was terrific in defeat last time out behind one of his key rivals in this race FINAL DEADLINE (7). He was forced to do all the work there and was beaten under a length. If he can hold the advantage of the handicap in this race he should be a very good chance of turning the tables. FINAL DEADLINE (7) was able to find the front and lead all the way last time out beating FATE AWAITS (4). He looks less suited the way this race could pan out given he will need to overcome a 30m metre handicap giving some of his key rivals a head start. PATH TO GREATNESS (2) continues to make a mess of the start in stands which has proved costly for him on a number of occasions including last start when missing the start badly and being forced to make a wide run into it in the fastest part of the race. If he can bring better manners early he would become a chance in this race. DRAGON (1) ran a good race last time out when sitting without cover and running a good second to stablemate Greased Lightnin. He looks well handicapped starting on the front but does meet some classy types in this race and will need a lot to go his way to be a winning hope. SELECTIONS: FATE AWAITS (4), FINAL DEADLINE (7), PATH TO GREATNESS (2), DRAGON (1) SUGGESTED BET: FATE AWAITS (4) to win.

POCKET BOOK (7) was forced to race without cover last time out over the 2138 which likely wouldn’t have suited her. She is likely to get back in the run in this race and should be running on strongly late. SPORTS BOUNTY (4) had a tough run last time out and was well beaten behind stablemate Azor Ahai. He was an impressive winner his start prior rating good time at this track and trip. HARRY KANE (10) got back in the run and was running on strongly late in a race taken out by he Maybe Bettor over the 2138. He has seemingly been best through his career over the 1660 and should get a good run off the speed. MACS A DUDE (5) secured a good run behind the leader last time out and was running on late into third. He should get a good run off the speed and can look to be running on late. SELECTIONS: POCKET BOOK (7), SPORTS BOUNTY (4), HARRY KANE (10), MACS A DUDE (5) SUGGESTED BET: POCKET BOOK (7) to win.

SWEET ROCKY (2) has some gate speed and should be able to press forward and race in a prominent position in this race. He was very good two starts ago when sitting without cover and just being run down late by Studleigh Mark who had done no work. UNCLE TONY (8) should get a good run through in this race following a gate speed horse in the early stages. He was able to find the front in a similar race last time out and scored an easy enough win there. With luck in running he should be running on late. FIFTY THREE STARS (5) was able to lead and win comfortably enough on Saturday at Albion Park. He draws to get less favours in this race but can still find a prominent position and should run well again. BONNIES CAM (1) has good gate speed and should be able to lead early before having options from there. He seems to be best when driven with a sit at this stage of his career and was running on strongly last time out into a close up fifth behind All Eyes On Bling. SELECTIONS: SWEET ROCKY (2), UNCLE TONY (8), FIFTY THREE STARS (5), BONNIES CAM (1) SUGGESTED BET: SWEET ROCKY (2) to win.

IAM HUGO (8) started a short price favourite last time out and didn’t have much luck there when well beaten. He looks to find a race where he should get a soft run on the pegs just behind the speed and should be running on strongly late. STUDLEIGH ANNE (1) was able to secure a good run last time out at this track and was able to finish best to score. She draws well in this race and may be able to drive through and lead in the early stages which should see her hard to run down. UBETONRED (10) found the front two starts ago and was able to score a big win leading all the way. He then had less luck in a stronger race and was well beaten. He can look to bounce back in this race. SHEZ A PUNTER (6) put in a very good run last time out when being shuffled right back early before running on strongly late into third. She looks likely to be shuffled back again in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: IAM HUGO (8), STUDLEIGH ANNE (1), UBETONRED (10), SHEZ A PUNTER (6) SUGGESTED BET: IAM HUGO (8) to win.

RACANA (4) wasn’t quite at her absolute best last time out when securing a very good run before running on just fairly late into fourth behind Our Sweet Jess. She has a good draw in this race and can look to press forward and find a prominent position. COSMIC FLYER (11) drops right back in class into this race having raced Leap To Fame last time out in the FFA. He should get a good run off the speed and if there is any tempo on he should be running on strongly. BART BENTLEY (10) found trouble last time out and took no part there. He was very impressive his start prior when first up for the stable of Mitch Cox and can bounce back in this race. KEAYANG KAUNA (7) returns to QLD after having six starts in NSW for three seconds and a win. She has good ability and despite the wide she should run well in this company. SELECTIONS: RACANA (4), COSMIC FLYER (11), BART BENTLEY (10), KEAYANG KAUNA (7) SUGGESTED BET: COSMIC FLYER (11) to win. OVERVIEW: This looks like an even contest to open the meeting, with many winning chances. THEROUX (11) looks on paper like he has been unable to find his best form this preparation, but things haven’t really gone his way. He does have the best sectional times in this event. Barrier 11 will make it tricky, but the middle distance helps. Similarly, KNOW THE SCORE (8) has been racing well but will need some luck from the barrier. He’s been letting down nicely in recent runs. HOME AND DRY (4) battled on well for third last start after racing in the breeze. The start prior, he flashed home strongly to win at Cranbourne. He is versatile in this grade. THE REGULATOR (2) hasn’t had a lot of luck recently, getting back in the field and covering too much extra ground. His runs have still been solid. He should be able to map more forward from barrier two, even though he doesn’t have electric gate speed. IAMAWINGATE (1) has a good turn of foot and enough gate speed to take advantage of barrier one. SELECTIONS: THEROUX (11), IAMAWINGATE (1), HOME AND DRY (4), KNOW THE SCORE (8)

OVERVIEW: SNOWIN (2) has been brave in defeat in her two career runs to date. Last start at Ballarat, she chased home No Repentance and was beaten by just a head after running strongly to the line. She’s a very well-bred Bold Eagle filly and should benefit from barrier two here. ASONGOFTHEHEART (8) was a good third on debut following a nice trial. She was chasing home Snowin and No Repentance and let down nicely. She should improve again with experience. WALKING ON WATER (7) is a pacing-bred trotter and one of the more experienced trotters in this field. She tired last start in a much tougher event but was a good second at this track the start prior. ROYAL LADY (6) is an interesting trotter here. She has some quality trial form, but in her one career start she got it wrong with her manners. She looks like she could be an exciting trotter once she puts it all together. BACK: SNOWIN (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:SNOWIN (2), ASONGOFTHEHEART (8), WALKING ON WATER (7), ROYAL LADY (6)

OVERVIEW: COOL STORY (9) has been racing OK but has endured a run of bad luck. He follows out fast beginner HURRICANE HOOLY (2) and should get a good trip. He has the best sectional times in this event. BRAVE ART (1) is second-up for the Carson Millar stable. She couldn’t make up ground last start in a strong field on a rain-affected track after pulling back from a wide barrier. She should get a better run from barrier one. WINGATE GUY (7) has won two of his last three starts and powered home from well back to win impressively last start. The barrier makes it tougher here. UNDERATTACK (8) resumed last month after more than two years away. He let down well but needed the run for fitness and should improve here. SELECTIONS:COOL STORY (9), BRAVE ART (1), WINGATE GUY (7), UNDERATTACK (8)

OVERVIEW: This looks to be a competitive race with a number of good chances. NORMANDY NUGGET (5) has a great turn of foot and enough gate speed to map well here. He sustained a good run for third at this track last start in rain-affected conditions and is racing well. FAKE CULLECTION (8) led and tired a little late when first-up. She won well at her start prior to going for a break and should improve with fitness. With the right run, she can be flashing home late. ICANMOTOR (7) is racing well and flashed home nicely for second at this track last start. He’ll need some luck from the barrier. IMAGUNNARESTNGO (3) can be quirky at times, but she has a solid turn of foot with the right run. She’ll need to map well to be a threat late. Also respecting BLUE OCEAN (1) from the ace barrier. BACK: NORMANDY NUGGET (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:NORMANDY NUGGET (5), FAKE CULLECTION (8), ICANMOTOR (7), IMAGUNNARESTNGO (3).

OVERVIEW: ULTIMATE VINNIE (8) is a very smart horse who is well placed here. Last start at Terang, he raced wide in a race run near track-record time. It was a super run. He’s been unlucky at Free For All level, and from barrier eight he should stay out of trouble here. IMA TERMINATOR (7) is a smart horse at his best and has had some really tough runs recently, including in the breeze. He may need to make his own luck again here, but he has the ability. DONMARO (5) is a smart ex-New Zealand performer who probably hasn’t shown his best since moving to Australia earlier this year. He has had a few issues in his starts here but is first-up after a short break and trialled impressively at Melton last week. KING SAINT (6) was brave last start in the breeze at Shepparton. He’s a versatile horse who can make his own luck. From barrier one, STEEL THE MOMENT (1) should get a good trip here. SELECTIONS:ULTIMATE VINNIE (8), IMA TERMINATOR (7), DONMARO (5), KING SAINT (6).

OVERVIEW: PURPLE MOON (8) is a talented Menangle-trained filly campaigning in Victoria. Two starts ago, she missed away, recovered to catch the field and flashed home into second. Last start, she was checked out of the field but again recovered to hit the line strongly. As the only horse on the back row, she should have time to settle early. JOE LOU (7) is a talented, in-form trotter who has won five of his last eight starts. The barrier presents a challenge, but James Herbertson takes the reins and will be able to navigate the tricky draw. CHAMPAGNES (5) is another in-form trotter who is consistently competitive and can’t be left out of the numbers. She faces an awkward barrier but is racing well enough to overcome it. NO TELLING HEATHER (4) led throughout to win well at this track last start and should be able to secure another favourable run here. BACK: PURPLE MOON (8) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:PURPLE MOON (8), JOE LOU (7), CHAMPAGNES (5), NO TELLING HEATHER (4)

OVERVIEW: This is a quality trotting event. ADELAIDE RED (7) and ZARSKI (1) are both talented, progressive trotters who look likely to feature in upcoming Group 1 races. ADELAIDE RED (7) is already a Group 1 winner, having taken out the Breeders Crown 2yo Trotting Fillies Final last year. She ran home strongly for third in the Vicbred Super Series 3yo Trotting Fillies Final last start. She is a smart filly but will need to overcome the awkward barrier here. ZARSKI (1) raced in the breeze and suffered a flat tyre last start in the Vicbred Super Series Final won by Sam Nien. He is a talented top-level trotter who will appreciate barrier one here. SOLOTREKK (2) looks an exciting trotter who continues to take the next step. He clearly has plenty of ability but is yet to be tested at the top level. This is a tough test, but it will be a good gauge of whether he can take another step forward. THE SKY IS THE LIMIT (4) has a nice turn of foot and will be running home strongly with the right run. BACK: ADELAIDE RED (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ADELAIDE RED (7), ZARSKI (1), SOLOTREKK (2), THE SKY IS THE LIMIT (4)

OVERVIEW: NIGHT FLIGHT (4) is in terrific form and performs well at this track. He has great gate speed and was a good winner last start. This is a little harder, but he continues to improve. POPPY POPSTAR (2) doesn’t have the strongest numerical form, but she has nice ability on her day. She should find the fence early and gets a good opportunity here. WHY NOW (5) is a lightly raced trotter having his sixth career start, but he appears to be a progressive type. He does have his quirks and is still learning what racing is all about, so there are some question marks over where he maps here. He does have the best sectional times in this event. JAKARTA (7) has been a little unlucky recently but is racing well. His main rivals have better barriers, which makes things tricky for him here. BACK: NIGHT FLIGHT (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:NIGHT FLIGHT (4), POPPY POPSTAR (2), WHY NOW (5), JAKARTA (7) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

HOOKLINEANDSINKER (5) put together a nice run at Mildura last start when she ran second behind CALF PEN. Her stable and driver must be respected in this sort of race. PERFECT PLAYGIRL (2) looks like the main danger after a strong win at Kapunda last start. CENTREFOLD STAR (7) and HUGH GO (6) are both big chances in an even race.

TRIGGER (4) finds his race today after running around the mark against tougher fields. He should be storming home over the concluding stages in a race like this. WHATA OPTIMIST (5) snuck up along the inside to run second at Kapunda last start. He finds a winnable race today and he looks like a strong chance after two encouraging seconds over his last two starts. ROCKNROLL YANKEE (1) and CLARENDEN LEGACY (2) are also chances.

ONE AUSSIE (5) finished down the track last start in a tougher race. His debut run was very impressive when he defeated SOUTH AUSSIE STAR by a neck. Today will be easier for him and he should be able to bounce back and repeat that debut run today. BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (2), NO GOOD REASON (4) and CECIL PEAK (7) are all chances.

HAYOAK (6) will prefer the mobile start against an easier field today. She has the potential to be a major improver and it may pay to watch her market moves. BISHOP GEORGE (7) is first up from a break but he will love the mobile start. If he is anywhere near his best he is a massive chance. TRANQUIL BILL (3) and STAR OF PATRICK (2) are also chances.

LAYLAS PRINCESS (8) was a winner four starts back. She usually performs well in these sort of races. She is drawn well to use her sprint as well. If she is anywhere near her best then she will be hard to beat. ROCKNROLL SPIRIT (6) has won his last two starts and is racing in some strong form. ALWAYS ON SAFARI (2) and GUEST ARTIST (7) are also chances.

LOCHINVAR RULER (2) hasn’t been his best recently but today he finds an easier race from a winnable draw. He could possibly find the lead which would make him hard to catch. BRANSON (7) was a last start winner and he is a major chance if he can repeat that run today. BRUZER (1) and WELL WELL (8) are also chances.

SWEETKINDOFMAGIC (7) can do things wrong but when he paces smoothly he usually features heavily. He defeated LORD MYRMECIA by 1.9 metres last start. He will need some luck from the draw but this is the sort of race he can win. PARISIAN BANDIT (4), LIGHTNING BLING (1) and FEAR THE BANKER (6) are also chances.

BROBENAH GIRL (4) has been knocking on the door for another win recently after running some handy second placings. If she can get the right run into the race then she should be storming home. MICKTHEBESTBUTCHER (6) is better than what he has been showing recently. He could be a major improver today. BELLA ROMA (1) and MY GIRL MIA (2) are also chances. OVERVIEW: OVER HERE (4) is having his third career start for in-form trainer-driver Donna Castles. On debut, he did a few things wrong but still ran home impressively after losing ground when galloping during the race. Last start, he was brave in defeat when second after sustaining a strong run late. He looks well placed here. GYM QUEEN (2) is an ultra-consistent mare, and it’s surprising she is still a maiden. She returned from a break with a good third last start and battled well to the line. She should improve with fitness. KYVALLEY JOYRIDE (3) is a well-bred son of Muscle Hill for top trotting trainer Brent Lilley. He showed promise earlier in his career but appears better than his recent form suggests. If he can use his gate speed to map well here, he could turn his form around. SKYE DIVA (9) has had two career starts and got her manners wrong on both occasions. She showed some OK trial form before her debut. We will learn more about her if she trots throughout, which may be the case here as the back-row barrier gives her space to settle early. BACK: OVER HERE (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: OVER HERE (4), GYM QUEEN (2), KYVALLEY JOYRIDE (3), SKYE DIVA (9)

OVERVIEW: ALTIUS (3) is a high gate-speed performer who will likely find the fence first here. He has had two months since his last start after injuring his eye during the run, but the freshen-up should benefit him. BELLA LOUISE (11) is in the twilight of her racing career before heading to the breeding barn. She won well last start when leading. The barrier is different here, but she has the winning confidence. TALISKER SKIPPER (1) has had the best season of his career in 2026 and continues to perform well. He got well back in a recent trial from barrier one but ran home OK into second. He is racing well, but the barrier is a query as he could get shuffled back on the fence. If he can map well, he is a threat here. DARETODANCE (8) is third-up after a year away from racing. She ran home well first-up at Maryborough, then was slightly inconvenienced up the straight last start but still performed well. She should improve again with race fitness. SPUN SILVER (2) is another fast beginner who could find the top here. VIVA STORM (6) drops in class after racing through the Vicbred Super Series. First starter HOLLOW LOG (7) is well bred and one to watch here. SELECTIONS:ALTIUS (3), BELLA LOUISE (11), TALISKER SKIPPER (1),DARETODANCE (8)

OVERVIEW: HELLO POSSUMS (3) has notably the best sectional times in this event. Last start, she was pulled up with a flat tyre. The start prior, she hit the line brilliantly in the Vicbred Super Series 4yo Mares Silver Pace won by Ideal Moth. She has the class. IM BIG BUSINESS (9) is a smart gelding first-up since July. He looked strong in a recent Shepparton trial, sustaining a long run. ANAKIN (4) is second-up here and should improve on his first-up third at Kilmore behind Soho Playgirl and Popcornfriday. He made up plenty of ground last start and probably couldn’t have done much better. KRISSY (5) is racing in great form and seems to have benefited from her recent move to the state. Two starts ago, she won at Charlton after working to the front and proving too strong. She followed that with an impressive second at Shepparton, where she made a stunning sprint around the field at the 800-metre mark before being run down late by a smart performer. She is racing very well. BACK: HELLO POSSUMS (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:HELLO POSSUMS (3), IM BIG BUSINESS (9), ANAKIN (4), KRISSY (5)

OVERVIEW: MONEY TALKS (5) looped the field from last to first to win last start at Kilmore. He is a striking-looking horse who is racing well, although this is a step up in class. SUZYS DREAM (8) had a good trip last start, but the way she let down over the final 400 metres was eye-catching as she powered to victory. She has a brilliant turn of foot. ALLWATFUNJINGLES (4) was held up last start but flashed home once he found clear running late. He’s racing well and has the winning confidence. CHINSKI (9) has regained his best form this preparation, with four starts producing a win and three seconds. He has been using his gate speed to find a forward position in recent runs, so barrier nine may see him adopt a different race map. Daryl Douglas takes the drive for the first time. Also respecting KALARNEY PRINCE (2) here. SELECTIONS:MONEY TALKS (5), SUZYS DREAM (8), ALLWATFUNJINGLES (4), CHINSKI (9)

OVERVIEW: ASHANTE WARRIOR (6) is first-up here for Alex Ashwood. He does have his quirks and can do things wrong, but he has shown promise at stages throughout his short career. He has notably the best sectional times in this event. LATHER WITH FIRE (3) is having her third career start, with both previous runs coming at the smaller Mildura track. Last start, she got well back but ran home strongly. She doesn’t look like remaining a maiden for long. DYGANALI (5) was good last start, covering an extra 21 metres while racing wide but finishing only 3.9 metres from the winner. She has been close to breaking through for her maiden victory on several occasions recently and just needs the right trip. SEW HOPEFULL (2) is racing well and should be able to map positively from barrier two. BACK: ASHANTE WARRIOR (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ASHANTE WARRIOR (6), LATHER WITH FIRE (3), DYGANALI (5), SEW HOPEFULL (2)

OVERVIEW: JESSICAS STORY (4) is a versatile mare with a good turn of foot. She can be saved for her speed, do work or be used off the arm. Respecting her on her consistent and solid racing. SKYVALLEY BOY (8) is first-up here since July. He has shown glimpses of decent ability when he gets everything right and trialled well recently at Maryborough. SILENT REVERIE (2) showed her great gate speed to lead last start and was only narrowly beaten late. The return to the shorter trip suits. KOUFAX (3) is second-up here. He was good first-up on a rain-affected track, finishing just 8.4 metres from the winner. He should improve from that run. SELECTIONS:JESSICAS STORY (4), SKYVALLEY BOY (8), SILENT REVERIE (2), KOUFAX (3)

OVERVIEW: SPIRITED GIGI (3) is a gelding who has always shown promise. Last start, he finished third in the Vicbred Super Series 3yo Bronze Trot after looping the field impressively late. He gets his chance to return to the winners’ circle here. HAMMER (8) is a talented trotter who placed in a Breeders Crown heat last year. His connections had a big opinion of him before his debut. He has been lightly raced but clearly has ability. We will learn more about where he is at in this run, but fitness will be a query. ALDEBARAN MISTIQUE (6) has the best sectional times in this event. She was a good second behind No Money No Honey last start. She has a good turn of foot, but this barrier is challenging. KYVALLEY REEVA (10) is in great form, having won her last two starts impressively. This looks harder, though, and she has a wide back-row barrier, so she won’t find the front. Also respecting lightly raced CLASSIC FAIR (2) here. BACK: SPIRITED GIGI (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SPIRITED GIGI (3),HAMMER (8), ALDEBARAN MISTIQUE (6), KYVALLEY REEVA (10),

OVERVIEW: HEAVENLY GEM (2) is an exciting young filly. She finished third in the Vicbred Super Series Final behind Kahula and Ideal Frankie after flashing home impressively. That followed a very strong heat performance where she raced in the breeze. She’s versatile and has plenty of ability. CASTERTON (11) is an Emma Stewart-trained performer having his second start. He got it wrong with his manners on debut and tailed out, but he had trialled well beforehand. Stable respect here. HOSO MAGIC (10) doesn’t have the strongest numerical form, but she has been competing in the Vicbred Super Series. She faces another tough assignment from a challenging barrier here, but she has ability. TECHYS WISH (7) is a first starter for Nathan Jack. She was second in a recent trial. BACK: HEAVENLY GEM (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: HEAVENLY GEM (2), CASTERTON (11), HOSO MAGIC (10), TECHYS WISH (7)

OVERVIEW: OZZIE DIAMOND (6) flashed home strongly to break through for her maiden victory last start. She had been racing well prior but hadn’t had much luck. She’ll need some luck again here, but now has the winning confidence. BLISSFULL LILLY (2) hasn’t had much luck recently and carried a flat tyre last start, so that run can be forgiven. She’s been racing well and, with some luck here, is a winning chance. TOUCH OF REALITY (9) should get a good trip early. If saved for one run, she’ll be flashing home late. DELTA STARZ (1) has a strong last 800-metre sectional compared with the other runners in this field. She should get the perfect trip from barrier one. SELECTIONS:OZZIE DIAMOND (6),BLISSFULL LILLY (2), TOUCH OF REALITY (9), DELTA STARZ (1)

OVERVIEW: ARRAPS (3) was a good third last start at Shepparton. She did all the work in the run and was just outsprinted late by fresh runners. She is racing well enough to win this. MIKI MARK (8) has consistently been performing well and rarely puts in a bad run. He has the best gate speed but will need some luck from the barrier. CHASING THE WIND (1) has the ace barrier and should have options early, either taking a sit or holding a forward position. FAVOURITEHIGHLIGHT (9) let down well last start to finish third after getting a good trip in the 1-1. She should get another good run here. SELECTIONS:ARRAPS (3), MIKI MARK (8), CHASING THE WIND (1), FAVOURITEHIGHLIGHT (9) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:THE GOLDEN HOOK (3) is racing in outstanding form and should prove hard to beat from his good draw. He worked forward to find the lead and blitzed his rivals at Gawler then followed with a brave second behind Luvtobeuptome in the Mildura Guineas. GOOD BOOTS BINDI (8) went back to last from a wide draw and was making ground before running into a dead-end late when an unlucky fifth behind Royal Saxon at Mildura last outing. She finished a close second behind the smart pacer Lewielewis prior so she will take holding out in the run to the finish. CHEERS POVERTY (2) is a fast beginner and performs best when he is able to lead. He attempted to lead throughout when a close second behind Royal Saxon last outing. STARVIN MARVIN (1) will appreciate his best draw for some time and has claims along with MY ULTIMATE BILLY (9). BACK: THE GOLDEN HOOK (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: THE GOLDEN HOOK (3), GOOD BOOTS BINDI (8), CHEERS POVERTY (2), STARVIN MARVIN (1)

OVERVIEW: It is a very open race with many winning chances. FLAME BLASTER (1) is perfectly drawn to suit his racing pattern and won from behind the leader at Mildura on August 21 so he is worth an investment. POTTSY THE GURU (2) hasn’t raced since August 2025 but he put together three straight victories at the end of his last preparation and he wasn’t beaten by far at the trials on Wednesday. He should go well from his good draw. CARLISLE CRUISER (8) was shuffled back on the markers after commencing from the inside of the second line and ran home fairly well for fourth behind Calf Pen last outing. He is worth a ticket each way from his trailing draw. SHES POPPY (11) pushed forward to find the lead from a wide draw and won comfortably on Wednesday. She does perform best when she is close to the speed and being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but she won well enough last week to warrant respect. SELECTIONS: FLAME BLASTER (1), POTTSY THE GURU (2), CARLISLE CRUISER (8), SHES POPPY (11)

OVERVIEW: MAJOR LINCOLN (8) is yet to miss a place in five starts at Mildura and should run a good race again. He raced without cover throughout when a brave third behind SUNSHINE WARRIOR (9) last outing and he should go close from his trailing draw. SUNSHINE WARRIOR (9) showed very good gate speed to lead, kicked well clear on the home turn and held on to win at Mildura last outing. He drops back to the second line now but this race is no harder so he must be considered as a winning chance again. PUNTO CALIENTE (6) has been finding the line strongly at his most recent performances and is worth thought again. He came from last at his latest eye-catching third behind Keilah. FLEUR BELLA (5) is a fast beginner and her chances will be enhanced if she is able to find the lead around the first turn. HESASTAR (7) was a winner against similar opposition at Mildura on September 18 and has claims with normal luck in running. BACK: MAJOR LINCOLN (8) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: MAJOR LINCOLN (8), SUNSHINE WARRIOR (9), PUNTO CALIENTE (6), FLEUR BELLA (5)

OVERVIEW: GETONTHEBUS (1) boasts reasonable trial form in South Australia and is perfectly drawn for her debut. Trainer Peter Bain boasts a good strike rate at Mildura and GETONTHEBUS (1) is related to the handy Mildura performer Avoca Blues so she is sure to be strongly fancied. FEEFIFOFUM (3) parked without cover throughout and raced greenly when a game third behind Edgar Bromac at his Mildura debut. He has ability and should keep improving with the benefit of racing. PHILS BOY (2) settled midfield and worked home fairly well for sixth behind Miss Adelia on debut. This race is easier and his trial form is respectable so he warrants respect. ELISSAS DELIGHT (9) and CRUEL MISTRESS (11) have place claims and if the emergency LIKE A LIBRARIAN (4) gains a start, she will be competitive. SELECTIONS: GETONTHEBUS (1), FEEFIFOFUM (3), PHILS BOY (2), ELISSAS DELIGHT (9)

OVERVIEW:TO THE NINES (1) left a trailing position to park without cover mid-race and battled on strongly for third behind Gunforhire in fast time at Melton then followed with a close up fourth behind Pick Up Elvis in a strong race. He has returned from a spell in outstanding form and should prove hard to beat from the pole position. PRIORITISE (7) gained a one out and one back trail, came out three horses wide from the 600m and sustained a strong run when second behind My Ultimate Vinny on Wednesday. He is awkwardly drawn but appears to be well placed against this line up and is one of the leading chances again. SANTA CASA BEACH (6) is much better than his form reads and is capable of improving on his numerical form. He was held up badly behind tiring runners and seemed to have plenty in reserve when an unlucky ninth behind Hot Deal last outing. KYORETSU (5) possesses early speed and continues to perform strongly at Mildura so he warrants consideration. BACK: TO THE NINES (1) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: TO THE NINES (1), PRIORITISE (7), SANTA CASA BEACH (6), KYORETSU (5)

OVERVIEW:RANKINE (5) was slow to begin then circled around the field to park without cover when a big winner of the Lordship Stakes at Globe Derby when on debut. He overcame a tough run and won with plenty in reserve first up so he appears to have a promising future. SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (4) has joined trainer Robert Nolan since his latest race track appearance back in May. He looked impressive at a recent Mildura trial victory and must be respected. BAZZAS LEGACY (2) set up a genuine tempo in the lead when third behind Bersagliere two starts ago then followed with a distant fourth in the Mildura Guineas. He is perfectly drawn and should give a forward showing. COME ON BILLEE (3) didn’t have much room in the straight when fourth behind MY ULTIMATE HENRY (6) at his latest effort and is a place hope from his good draw. BACK: RANKINE (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: RANKINE (5), SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (4), BAZZAS LEGACY (2), COME ON BILLEE (3)

OVERVIEW: ACCELERE (1) led throughout to win over ROJENBYE (5) on September 11 then followed with a third behind Caulonia Terror. He is drawn to lead again and should continue to build on his consistent form line. CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (7) gained a nice trail and battled on fairly well for third behind My Ultimate Henry last outing. He has the perfect trailing draw behind the likely leader and should run a good race again. THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (3) settled in the second half of the field and attempted to sustain a long run from the 700m when third behind Neds Beach last outing. He is better drawn for this assignment and is worth a ticket each way. ROJENBYE (5) was hitting the line strongly at his latest fourth. He has returned to form recently and should be finding the line nicely again. SNEAKY PHILTRA (2) and KEAYANG CRIPPA (6) both have claims in an open race to end the program. SELECTIONS: ACCELERE (1), CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (7), THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (3), ROJENBYE (5)

MOONSHINE MILLY (9) should get a good run off the speed in this race. He got a good run off the speed last time out and was able to run over the top to beat Denis The Punter. He looks hard to beat again. PUNTERS JEWEL (10) looks well drawn to get a soft run through in the early stages of the race. He drew poorly last time out and wasn’t beaten too far at Albion Park by Dragon. He should be running on late. DELIGHTFULLY SWEET (5) was a very impressive first up winner when sitting without cover and racing clear late. She backed that up with a good second last time out behind Merry Jewel. ZAC DANIELS (2) has good gate speed and is likely to look to press for the lead in the early stages which is a position he seems to do his best racing in. If he was able to find the front in this race he could bounce back to some better form. SELECTIONS: MOONSHINE MILLY (9), PUNTERS JEWEL (10), DELIGHTFULLY SWEET (5), ZAC DANIELS (2) SUGGESTED BET: PUNTERS JEWEL (10) each way.

MAHINDI (9) did a lot of work last time out before being left without cover and was very good to run third behind Calling Buddy. She draws outside the back row but has been racing in good form and in an even field she should run well again. SOME CHEVRON (4) starts first up in this race for the stable of Alex Johnson having previously raced in NSW. He should settle close enough in the run and if he’s ready to go first up he should be running on late. BLACKJACK CRIPPA (5) was able to secure the ideal run close to the speed with cover last time out and ran on late into fourth behind Calling Buddy. He should get a good run off the speed in this race and if the race is run to suit he can be running on late. MARDIBRINGSPARTY (2) was shuffled back last time out in a race taken out by Stormtide over the 2040 at this track. She draws well and may be able to press to the lead and could be suited by the step back to the 1780 in this race. SELECTIONS: MAHINDI (9), SOME CHEVRON (4), BLACKJACK CRIPPA (5), MARDIBRINGSPARTY (2) SUGGESTED BET: MAHINDI (9) to win.

SWEET NELLIE JOY (6) led recently at this track and was run down late by Nitrator who had the perfect run on her back. She appears to have a key draw advantage on her main rivals in this race drawing the front row and can look to maintain that. MITCHELLS RUN (10) led last time out at this track and was just run down late by Jive Master. He is likely to have derived good benefit from the outing but does draw outside the back row this time. MALARKY (7) should get a good run through in this race behind a horse with reasonable early speed. She was able to lead recently at this track and trip and was just run down late by Magicol Idea. HYNOTIZE ME (1) draws well in this race and should be able to lead before having options from there. He was running on well late last time out into third behind Britts Mate. SELECTIONS: SWEET NELLIE JOY (6), MITCHELLS RUN (10), MALARKY (7), HYNOTIZE ME (1) SUGGESTED BET: SWEET NELLIE JOY (6) to win.

TAKE COURAGE (5) is a capable sit sprinter and could be suited getting back and running on in a race which could generate a good early tempo. She didn’t have a lot of luck last time out and was running on strongly late into second behind Doolittle Doozzie. SHADYS DELIGHT (7) looks suited over the track and trip but does face an awkward inside back row draw. He got back and was running on late last time out in a slowly run race. TACKAS LAST DANCE (10) struck trouble last time out at a crucial stage when locking stays and losing all momentum. She is likely to get a good run off the speed and should be running on late. TAURUS BROMAC (9) secured a good run close to the speed last time out and just battled on fairly there when finishing fourth. He is likely to get back in the run and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: TAKE COURAGE (5), SHADYS DELIGHT (7), TACKAS LAST DANCE (10), TAURUS BROMAC (9) SUGGESTED BET: TAKE COURAGE (5) to win.

ULTIMATE HUNTER (6) has been very impressive since landing in the stable of Matthew Johnstone scoring two nice wins. He has shown versatility winning from the breeze before finding the top and winning again. He should settle close enough and looks hard to beat. NEED NOT TO WARRY (9) looks set to get a good run off the speed in this race in a race which could generate a good early tempo. He got back in the run at Marburg and was running on nicely ROLLYARRRZ (2) has a good draw in this race but may not quite have the speed to work across to the pegs in the early stages of the race. He ran well last time out settling close to the speed and finishing third behind Pinkchampagne and Rosies Boy who both raced on the pegs in the run. VICTREE ATOM (1) has reasonable gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead before having options from there. He drew poorly first up when getting back and running on late at Albion Park. He should be better for the outing and can run well again. SELECTIONS: ULTIMATE HUNTER (6), NEED NOT TO WARRY (9), ROLLYARRRZ (2), VICTREE ATOM (1) SUGGESTED BET: ULTIMATE HUNTER (6) to win.

JOVIAL JIM (8) took on a strong race last time out taken out by Lots Of Change at Albion Park. He returns from a spell in this race and appears very well suited in this field. He should be hard to beat. WHAT IS HIS NAME (4) sat without cover last time out on an incredibly slow tempo in a race the leader was able to get away with plenty and out dashed him over the final 200m of the race. He should be able to work forward and find a prominent position and should go well from there. PAMPERED ART (1) was shuffled a long way back last time out before running on fairly late. She is likely to have derived benefit from the run and should get a good run in this race from an ideal draw. STRAWBERRIESNCREAM (2) secured a good run three back on the pegs last time out and was able to sprint nicely into second. She should get a good run close to the speed and can be running on late again. SELECTIONS: JOVIAL JIM (8), WHAT IS HIS NAME (4), PAMPERED ART (1), STRAWBERRIESNCREAM (2) SUGGESTED BET: JOVIAL JIM (8) to win.

AESTHETE (3) found the front last time out and was able to score an easy win leading all the way to beat Captains Run. He looks the leader again in this race and finds a weaker field which should see him incredibly hard to run down again. ROCKY OUTLOOK (6) impressed two starts ago when securing the perfect run leaders back before sprinting nicely to reel in Playing For Keeps late. He has a lot less favours from the wide draw in this race but should be running on well late if the race is run to suit. ORION ART (5) secured a good run two starts ago and battled on fairly there for third. She is likely to get less favours from a wide draw but does meet a field without a lot of depth. WICKED WHISKEY (1) started first up for a new stable last time out and was only able to manage eighth there but did take on a stronger field in a race taken out by Same Old Devil. He should get a good run close to the speed and can be thereabouts late. SELECTIONS: AESTHETE (3), ROCKY OUTLOOK (6), ORION ART (5), WICKED WHISKEY (1) SUGGESTED BET: AESTHETE (3) to win.

DISEMBARK (5) got a good run last time out off the speed in a stronger race before being badly held up at a crucial stage in a race taken out by Lots Of Heart. He looks the class horse in this field and should be hard to beat. OUTRUNTHETIDE (2) wasn’t seemingly suited last time out doing all the work in the run before fading out of it late at this track. If she was able to work to the lead in this race she could prove hard to run down. BOSTON BOUND (1) has good gate speed but has seemingly been best suited when driven with cover. She took a sit last time out and battled on fairly for third there behind Mcrockin at this track and trip. AURELIE (6) made a break again last time out taking her out of play. She was impressive first up this time in when making a break and recovering to finish third. With better manners she could run a good race. SELECTIONS: DISEMBARK (5), OUTRUNTHETIDE (2), BOSTON BOUND (1), AURELIE (6) SUGGESTED BET: DISEMBARK (5) to win. OVERVIEW:MISTER JIMARINGLE (1) ticks a few boxes to bounce back to winning form here. He strikes well over this distance and has a decent strike rate at this track, but his winning chances improve dramatically when he’s able to race on speed and dictate. Herbertson will no doubt use the draw to his advantage, with the map not working out last time when he was untested to the line. He finds a suitable grade compared with what he’s been opposed to and looks hard to beat. ROM BARO (10) is a 3yo who impressed last week at this track, winning in good time after leading all the way, dropping back out of the Vicbred Series. He goes to the back row now but deserves respect again. MAMMALS REASON (11) has a strong Shepparton profile, winning 4 from 8 here this season, all for the new stable. She goes to the back row, which makes things tougher, but her form is hard to ignore. IM DUSTEE (9) should be fitter now third up, and he hasn’t had much go his way in his two runs back, forced to sit outside the speed last time and settling too far back prior. Expect improvement. There are a few chances at the minor end, with TA KALCHE (8) likely to get a soft run and ANIMADO (3), MADAM REACTOR (4), MAJOR ORION (5) and GINGER ELLA (6) all racing well; they just have tricky draws to overcome. BACK: MISTER JIMARINGLE (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:MISTER JIMARINGLE (1), ROM BARO (10), MAMMALS REASON (11), IM DUSTEE (9)

OVERVIEW:PARINI (4) finds a winnable race to break his maiden after showing some promise in his five career starts, where often he hasn’t found an ideal set-up. He had nothing go his way first up, checked twice in running and crowded when making a run in the straight. He hasn’t shown gate speed to date, but this looks to be his most favourable opportunity to look for a forward spot and get every chance to break through. MAJOR FRIEND (11) has been racing well from better draws but goes from the pole to the outside of the back row. His form is better than most, so even though he’ll need luck, he warrants consideration. SON OF A BROAD (9) is first up from a break off a solid trial and, last preparation for the new stable, showed marked improvement, narrowly missing out twice when an odds-on favourite. Even though he will come on in fitness, the trailing draw and middle distance are in his favour. At the minor end, JUST MY LUCK (2) can improve as he’s likely to get a good trip, and it’s hard to know what to make of 2yo filly CARTIMANDUA (6), who was okay on debut but was quite poor when stepping up in grade since, while her trial wasn’t ideal. SLOWBURN (3) would also come into minor calculations with any scratchings. BACK: PARINI (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:PARINI (4), MAJOR FRIEND (11), SON OF A BROAD (9), JUST MY LUCK (2)

OVERVIEW:LUVERBOY (2) looks a really good value play, finally coming up with a good draw and looking to get a perfect map, likely behind the speed. Nearly half of his wins have come at this track, and when forced to be map-negative last week, he hit the line well when the race was over. The last time he got this likely map was in July when he won comfortably at Echuca from behind the speed. He’s a nice play on both totes. ELLEEGANT LANE (8) has really hit form this past month, winning 2 from 3, and at Melton no less, where she has run good time. Those wins have coincided with Liam Older, who seems to get on well with her, and although she’ll need luck from the draw, she deserves respect. TRYX VIXEN (4) drops well back in class from the Vicbred, but to be fair she didn’t make much of that last start when failing to beat one home, albeit in very quick time. If she can show better speed and find the front or race on speed, she can improve sharply; she must be kept safe. CRESCO THREEPEAT (9) is a tough type who races well at this track and grade. He beat home Ellegant Lane back in August. His chances depend on tempo. THERESHEWAS (5) and last-start winner YELLA (6) will need luck from the draw, but they should be considered for exotic plays. BACK: LUVERBOY (2) – 0.5 units (win) 1.5 units (place) SELECTIONS:LUVERBOY (2), ELLEEGANT LANE (8), TRYX VIXEN (4), CRESCO THREEPEAT (9)

OVERVIEW:ALCATRAZ GIRL (4) doesn’t bring strong numerical form, but her chances improve from what looks to be a nice map for her to roll forward and look for the top. She was a winner at this track and distance back in June when she found the lead and ran good time. Everything points to a form spike here based on those indicators, and she may represent value. WHERES WOOD WOOD (8) is just about racing in career-best form as a 9yo, winning 5 of her 15 races this season and placing another 8 times from 26 starts. She’s an exponent of the ratings system and often runs her best races when she drops back to this grade, looking well placed with the concessions, including that of Tasmyn Potter, who enjoys a good strike rate on her. KRAKEY (9) hasn’t won this season but is still racing okay. She was forced to do it tough outside the speed last week and looks to be an improver in this type of race. OLLY ODD POTTS (2) can be a little hard to catch, but she tends to run her best races in this class when she doesn’t do much work early and can come with one run. She must be kept safe. JOEYS HANGOVER (5) was a winner here last week when given every possible hope from a more favourable draw. Winning form is good form, however, so despite needing luck, he deserves to be considered again. BACK: ALCATRAZ GIRL (4) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS:ALCATRAZ GIRL (4), WHERES WOOD WOOD (8), KRAKEY (9), OLLY ODD POTTS (2)

OVERVIEW:AMADA VILLMA (5) has been very well supported in her past two runs and was narrowly beaten last time after being shuffled back the start prior. She looks to get her chance to lead again over the short trip here, and although she’s a 20-start maiden, with Herbertson sticking she gets a great chance to break through. EAGLEYE (9) has mixed her form in three runs for the new stable, but it’s a stable worth respecting, particularly at this level. Her run two back suggested she could go on with it, so if she brings that effort, she’s in the mix. BETTOR DOO (3) was fair here last week after having every chance, but that was a harder race than he faces here. This is only his 2nd run for the new stable, so he is open to further improvement. BERYLS BOOTS (6) has found form over the past month, placing at his past five runs. He’ll be dependent on the right cover, but he’s worth consideration. BACK: AMADA VILLMA (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: AMADA VILLMA (5), EAGLEYE (9), BETTOR DOO (3), BERYLS BOOTS (6)

OVERVIEW: Concession drivers race with a couple of different form lines. This is the lowest-confidence race of the night; it will come down to luck in running. Suggest field in the Quaddie. TOORAM DANNY (4) is one of those who brings a different lead-in, being fresh up off a decent trial at Echuca. He can be map-positive from this draw, and his only victory came when he led all the way over a similar trip. He has upside, whereas much of the opposition is exposed as far as form is concerned. OUR MYSTERY BET (6) comes out of a tougher race here last week after bringing some consistent form without winning. He sat parked and dropped out here last week, and on face value he was disappointing. He will likely sit outside the speed again, but on previous form he demands respect. ANGELIC ATTITUDE (7) is a tricky one to line up, racing in southern NSW with mixed results. The stable deserves respect, so she’s in the mix. LORIMERMAJOR (1) hasn’t won for a while but gets an economical run from the draw here. He got dragged back out of it last week, so he may be open to improvement. SELECTIONS: TOORAM DANNY (4), OUR MYSTERY BET (6), ANGELIC ATTITUDE (7), LORIMERMAJOR (1)

OVERVIEW: This is another concession drivers’ race, this time for the trotters. BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (4) brings what few others do in this race, and that’s current winning form. His victory two back was quite good when he was able to find the front and beat a similar-quality field to what he meets here. The stable thought enough of him to have a shot at the Vicbred last month, and the fact Riley Pace was a winner on him under normal conditions, against his junior rivals this time, appeals. PATNWILL (1) is up in grade, but he is a quick beginner suited by the mile. He was able to lead all the way from an inside draw at Melton five runs back, and a repeat of that will see him hard to catch. They appear to be the main winning hopes on form. COURAGES LAW (6) hasn’t been able to put it together this season but did show ability as a juvenile and can feature if he recaptures that. Stablemate AFRICAN GALA (7) went close to winning two back and did things wrong last time, but he appears to be racing a little better, while MONTANA MUSCLE (5) is the veteran of the field and has won three times this season, which holds her in good stead. BACK: BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (4) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS: BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (4), PATNWILL (1), MONTANA MUSCLE (5), AFRICAN GALA (7)

OVERVIEW:DEMBE (3) was a very good winner here last week in good time when he was able to map well and let down with a sprint to win easily. The driver/map combination is particularly pleasing here, with a proactive map position likely over the middle trip. He’s the one to beat again. CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (5) is a big market watch here, being first up from NZ without a trial, and his NZ form is sound enough. Where he particularly stays under notice is with the astute trainer/driver combination at this level. RONNIE THE HAMMER (6) was first up here last week and performed well, considering the depth of the race and having to try to lead them up with fitness to come. He will be open to solid improvement. INTERPRETATION (4) ran 5th in the race that Dembe won last week but was drawn outside the back row and now draws to map closer. His form in Qld prior was okay, and he won’t be far away. SELECTIONS:DEMBE (3), CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (5), RONNIE THE HAMMER (6), INTERPRETATION (4)
